title: docs(pm-skill): record the spec lane's ledger-append class pre-approval; give the hotcrm lane a patrol criterion it can satisfy
body:
Closes #11368, closes #11516.

Two lane-file facts, folded into one PR because both are one-bullet recordings into
ceilinged files. Gate union re-run at the final commit `922ee8f9`; no changeset (this
diff is `.claude/**` only and publishes nothing — `skip-changeset` applied).

## Per item

| 落点 | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `references/lanes/spec.md` 常设承诺 (#11368) | no ledger-append rule at all — `git grep -n "ledger" lanes/spec.md` = 0 hits | one bullet carrying the class pre-approval, its three conditions and the out-of-class boundary (4 lines) |
| `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` 常设承诺 (#11516) | nothing about the patrol; SKILL.md's execution-seat first criterion applies unqualified and is unsatisfiable in that repo | one bullet recording the measured absence, the vacuous step, and the manual half a hotcrm seat reads instead (4 lines) |
| `lanes/spec.md` ceiling | 46 lines (headroom 0) | 46 lines (headroom 0) — **not raised** |
| `lanes/hotcrm.md` ceiling | 57 lines (headroom 0) | 57 lines (headroom 0) — **not raised** |

## #11368 — the pre-approval line

The card's drafted text, landed with its substance intact and rendered in the file's own
idiom (the lane files are Chinese prose; the draft already ended in it). **Written
id-free on purpose**: `check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans every `.md` under
`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` with `/#[0-9]{3,}/`, so the card's suggested precedent-PR
citation could not be included — the rule stands on its own conditions instead, which is
what that gate exists to enforce.

Not incorporated, and deliberately so: the engine seat's comment on the card suggests the
lane file state the *test* ("does this defect give a consumer a branch it could act on
differently?") rather than only the permission. That would extend the spec seat's ruling
rather than record it, and this card is a recording card — filed separately as #12100 so
it outlives this card.

## #11516 — premise moved while the card sat, and the sweep result

**The line the card names is already gone.** `lanes/hotcrm.md` no longer opens 常设承诺
with the patrol-anchor sentence: PR #11393 (`6d35509`, 2026-08-24) deleted that sentence
from **all seven** lane files after hoisting one copy into `SKILL.md` 执行座位职责. The
card's own grading comment recorded "all 7 lane files reference the patrol (measured
today)" — that reading was against a stale tree; on `origin/main`
`grep -rn "half-state-patrol" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/` returns **zero**.

**So the sibling sweep the card asked for has a different answer than expected**: it is
not "six siblings point at repos where the patrol runs" — it is *no lane file carries the
sentence at all*. The duty now lives once, in `SKILL.md` 执行座位职责 (plus the H17 index
read in 派发前必查), and it binds execution seats **unconditionally**.

**The defect therefore survived the deletion**, just relocated: a hotcrm seat reading
SKILL.md still meets a ⛔-carrying first criterion it cannot clear. This PR settles that
for the hotcrm seat at the place the grading named — in the lane file, by
recording the repo fact and naming the readable substitute — and does **not** touch
`SKILL.md`, whose wording covers objectstack/objectui seats too, where the patrol does
run. Provisioning the patrol in hotcrm stays declined per the grading.

Measurement, re-run today rather than assumed: `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at HEAD holds 14
workflows (`changeset-check`, `ci`, `code-quality`, `codeql`, `deploy-docs`, `docs-app`,
`e2e`, `label-sync`, `labeler`, `link-check`, `publish-production`, `publish-staging`,
`release`, `stale`) and **no `half-state-patrol.yml`** — read from a fresh clone, since
this session has git read but no GitHub API access to that repo. The anchor-issue half
(`tracking`-labelled open issues = 0, with the unfiltered control at 86) is the card's
2026-08-24 measurement, not re-run here; the landed text rests on the workflow reading and
states the inference explicitly (无 workflow 即无锚 issue). The already-fixed changeset
paragraph is untouched.

## Paying for both bullets — the compression arithmetic

Both files sit at headroom 0, so eight added lines were bought back. Every other change in
this diff is a re-wrap produced by the ratchet's **own** `wrapLine` export, so the wraps
are the canonical form the gate would produce and move whitespace only.

`lanes/spec.md`: +4 (new bullet) −4, from
(a) 一般开发工具面留 devx bullet re-wrapped 2→1;
(b) fixture-triage bullet re-wrapped 3→2;
(c) 候选卡评论必读 bullet: dropped 「看起来」, 2→1;
(d) 派发前触发文件 bullet: dropped the trailing 「跨仓 pin 滞后读法在 SKILL.md 多仓协调」
clause, 2→1. That clause was a bare signpost whose destination is still signposted twelve
lines above it in the same file (「判据见 SKILL.md 多仓协调」 on the objectui bullet), so
the pointer survives the cut.

`lanes/hotcrm.md`: +4 (new bullet) −4, from
(a) header paragraph re-wrapped 4→3;
(b) 双版本兼容 bullet re-wrapped 5→3;
(c) 依赖是已发布的 bullet: dropped the connective 「因此」, 3→2.

Proof that nothing else moved: with all whitespace stripped, the two files differ from
`origin/main` by exactly the two inserted bullets and the three declared deletions
(「看起来」, the pin-lag clause, 「因此」) — nothing else, in either file.
